biography.value: By bonding with divine beings and mastering mystical truths, archpriests become channels for the will of the gods and other supernatural powers. Their magic lets them perform wonders, spreading the kindness of their faith or unleashing divine fury. Some gather huge followings by claiming to speak for the divine, while others follow a personal spiritual path and seek to rise above mortal concerns.

description.value: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=PgTsQstaH96lbpM4]], each enemy in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. Failure: [[/damage 6d6 average type=radiant]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Stunned apply=false] condition until the end of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn. Success: Half damage only.

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]):

At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplLight00000]{Light}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplThaumaturg]{Thaumaturgy}

1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFlameStrik]{Flame Strike} (level 6 version), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGreaterRes]{Greater Restoration}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplRaiseDead0]{Raise Dead}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplZoneofTrut]{Zone of Truth}

The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplBless00000]{Bless}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDispelMagi]{Dispel Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplHealingWor]{Healing Word}, or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplLesserRest]{Lesser Restoration}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

A Holy Symbol takes one of the forms in the Holy Symbol table and is bejeweled or painted to channel divine magic. A Cleric or Paladin can use a Holy Symbol as a Spellcasting Focus.

The table indicates whether a Holy Symbol needs to be held, worn, or borne on fabric (such as a tabard or banner) or a Shield.
